name: BucketSortCriteria
description: Specifies criteria for sorting the results of a query for information about S3 buckets.

allOf.description: The name of the bucket property to sort the results by. This value can be one of the following properties that Amazon Macie defines as bucket metadata: accountId, bucketName, classifiableObjectCount, classifiableSizeInBytes, objectCount, sensitivityScore, or sizeInBytes.

The sort order to apply to the results, based on the value specified by the attributeName property. Valid values are: ASC, sort the results in ascending order; and, DESC, sort the results in descending order.
